Employees Attend CP20 Anime Expo

Agu 17, 2024
News About Dimen

We recently participated in the CP20 Anime Expo, a premier event that brings together anime enthusiasts, creators, and industry leaders.

During the expo, our team actively engaged with fans, showcased innovative projects such as NekoTalk and AppleTea, and highlighted our commitment to promoting anime culture.

This participation not only strengthened our connection with the anime community but also demonstrated our dedication to building a global platform where fans and creators can collaborate and grow together.
